meanings.en: a state of shame or loss of honour and respect
meanings.exampleEn: He brought dishonour on his family by cheating.
meanings.exampleTr: Hile yaparak ailesine onursuzluk getirdi.

meanings.en: to refuse to pay a cheque or bill
meanings.exampleEn: The bank may dishonour the cheque if there are insufficient funds.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeterli bakiye yoksa banka çeki ödemeyebilir.

meanings.en: something that discourages an action or effort
meanings.exampleEn: High taxes can be a disincentive to investment.
meanings.exampleTr: Yüksek vergiler yatırım için caydırıcı bir unsur olabilir.

meanings.en: a reluctance or unwillingness to do something
meanings.exampleEn: She showed a clear disinclination to discuss the matter.
meanings.exampleTr: Konuyu tartışmaya açık bir isteksizlik gösterdi.

meanings.en: to break into small pieces or fall apart
meanings.exampleEn: The old boat began to disintegrate in the water.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski tekne suda parçalanmaya başladı.

meanings.en: to lose strength or cohesion and fall apart
meanings.exampleEn: Their marriage slowly began to disintegrate.
meanings.exampleTr: Evlilikleri yavaş yavaş çökmeye başladı.

meanings.tr: mezardan çıkarma, defnedilmiş bir şeyi kazıp çıkarma
meanings.en: the act of digging up something that has been buried, especially a body
meanings.exampleEn: The court ordered the disinterment of the body for further examination.
meanings.exampleTr: Mahkeme, ek inceleme için cesedin mezardan çıkarılmasına karar verdi.

meanings.en: the quality of lacking coherence or logical connection
meanings.exampleEn: The disjointedness of his argument made it hard to follow.
meanings.exampleTr: Argümanının tutarsızlığı onu takip etmeyi zorlaştırdı.

meanings.en: to take a machine or structure apart
meanings.exampleEn: Engineers had to dismantle the engine to repair it.
meanings.exampleTr: Mühendisler onarmak için motoru sökmek zorunda kaldı.

meanings.en: to gradually get rid of a system or organization
meanings.exampleEn: The new government promised to dismantle the old bureaucracy.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni hükümet eski bürokrasiyi dağıtmayı vaat etti.

meanings.tr: dehşete düşmüş, hayal kırıklığına uğramış, üzülmüş
meanings.en: feeling shocked, worried or disappointed
meanings.exampleEn: She was dismayed to learn that the project had failed.
meanings.exampleTr: Projenin başarısız olduğunu öğrenince hayal kırıklığına uğradı.

meanings.en: in a way that shows something is not worth considering
meanings.exampleEn: He waved his hand dismissively and walked away.
meanings.exampleTr: Elini küçümseyerek salladı ve uzaklaştı.

meanings.en: to criticize someone or something in a way that shows you have no respect for them
meanings.exampleEn: She never disparages her competitors in public.
meanings.exampleTr: Rakiplerini asla halka açık olarak küçümsemez.

meanings.en: very different from each other and not able to be compared
meanings.exampleEn: The team brought together people from disparate backgrounds.
meanings.exampleTr: Ekip, birbirinden çok farklı geçmişlere sahip insanları bir araya getirdi.

meanings.en: not influenced by strong emotions; calm and impartial
meanings.exampleEn: We need a dispassionate analysis of the facts.
meanings.exampleTr: Gerçeklerin tarafsız bir analizine ihtiyacımız var.

meanings.en: a person who sends out vehicles, goods, or people to their destinations
meanings.exampleEn: The dispatcher radioed the drivers with their new routes.
meanings.exampleTr: Sevk görevlisi sürücülere yeni güzergâhlarını telsizle bildirdi.

meanings.en: special permission to do something that is normally not allowed
meanings.exampleEn: They were granted a special dispensation to marry.
meanings.exampleTr: Evlenmek için özel bir muafiyet verildi.

meanings.en: the act of distributing or providing something
meanings.exampleEn: The charity oversees the dispensation of food to the poor.
meanings.exampleTr: Yardım kuruluşu yoksullara gıda dağıtımını denetler.

meanings.en: to cause someone to lose enthusiasm or hope
meanings.exampleEn: The constant setbacks began to dispirit the whole team.
meanings.exampleTr: Sürekli aksilikler tüm ekibin moralini bozmaya başladı.

meanings.en: having lost enthusiasm and hope; discouraged
meanings.exampleEn: The players looked dispirited after losing the final.
meanings.exampleTr: Oyuncular finali kaybettikten sonra morali bozuk görünüyordu.

meanings.en: a state of low spirits and lack of enthusiasm
meanings.exampleEn: A general dispiritedness spread through the office after the layoffs.
meanings.exampleTr: İşten çıkarmalardan sonra ofise genel bir moral bozukluğu yayıldı.

meanings.en: to make someone annoyed or unhappy
meanings.exampleEn: His rude reply seemed to displease the manager.
meanings.exampleTr: Kaba cevabı yöneticiyi hoşnutsuz etmiş gibiydi.

meanings.en: to get rid of something you no longer want or need
meanings.exampleEn: Please dispose of the packaging in the recycling bin.
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen ambalajı geri dönüşüm kutusuna atarak imha edin.

meanings.en: a lack of balance or correct proportion between things
meanings.exampleEn: There is a clear disproportion between effort and reward here.
meanings.exampleTr: Burada çaba ile ödül arasında açık bir orantısızlık var.

meanings.en: too large or too small in comparison with something else
meanings.exampleEn: A disproportionate amount of the budget goes to marketing.
meanings.exampleTr: Bütçenin orantısız bir kısmı pazarlamaya gidiyor.

meanings.en: to a degree that is too large or too small compared to something else
meanings.exampleEn: The tax affects poorer households disproportionately.
meanings.exampleTr: Vergi, daha yoksul haneleri orantısız biçimde etkiliyor.

meanings.en: strong disagreement with an official or popular opinion
meanings.exampleEn: The proposal was passed with little dissent.
meanings.exampleTr: Öneri çok az muhalefetle kabul edildi.

meanings.en: to disagree officially with a decision or opinion
meanings.exampleEn: Two judges dissented from the majority ruling.
meanings.exampleTr: İki hâkim çoğunluk kararına karşı çıktı.

meanings.en: an action that harms someone or something
meanings.exampleEn: You do yourself a disservice by underselling your skills.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeteneklerini küçümseyerek kendine kötülük ediyorsun.

meanings.en: the state of being different from each other
meanings.exampleEn: Despite the dissimilarity in their styles, they work well together.
meanings.exampleTr: Tarzlarındaki farklılığa rağmen birlikte iyi çalışıyorlar.

meanings.en: swollen because of pressure from inside
meanings.exampleEn: The child had a distended belly from malnutrition.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocuğun karnı yetersiz beslenmeden dolayı şişmişti.

meanings.en: able to be recognized as different or separate
meanings.exampleEn: The two brands are barely distinguishable from each other.
meanings.exampleTr: İki marka birbirinden neredeyse ayırt edilemez.

meanings.en: changed from the true or natural shape, sound, or meaning
meanings.exampleEn: The report gave a distorted picture of the situation.
meanings.exampleTr: Rapor durumun çarpıtılmış bir resmini verdi.

meanings.tr: dalgın dalgın, dikkati dağınık bir şekilde
meanings.en: in a way that shows you are unable to concentrate
meanings.exampleEn: She nodded distractedly while checking her phone.
meanings.exampleTr: Telefonuna bakarken dalgın dalgın başını salladı.

meanings.en: a feeling of extreme worry, sadness, or pain
meanings.exampleEn: The news caused her great distress.
meanings.exampleTr: Haber ona büyük bir üzüntü yaşattı.

meanings.en: to make someone feel very upset or worried
meanings.exampleEn: It distresses me to see them argue.
meanings.exampleTr: Onların tartıştığını görmek beni üzüyor.

meanings.en: a long narrow channel dug in the ground for water or drainage
meanings.exampleEn: The car skidded off the road into a ditch.
meanings.exampleTr: Araba yoldan kayıp bir hendeğe girdi.

meanings.tr: (bir şeyden/birinden) kurtulmak, terk etmek, başından atmak
meanings.en: to get rid of or abandon something or someone
meanings.exampleEn: They decided to ditch the old plan and start again.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski planı bırakıp yeniden başlamaya karar verdiler.

meanings.en: developing in different directions; differing from each other
meanings.exampleEn: The two economists reached divergent conclusions.
meanings.exampleTr: İki ekonomist birbirinden farklı sonuçlara ulaştı.

meanings.en: able to be divided, especially without a remainder
meanings.exampleEn: Twelve is divisible by three and four.
meanings.exampleTr: On iki, üçe ve dörde bölünebilir.

meanings.en: causing disagreement or hostility between people
meanings.exampleEn: Immigration remains a divisive political issue.
meanings.exampleTr: Göç, bölücü bir siyasi mesele olmaya devam ediyor.

meanings.en: a female deer, rabbit, or hare
meanings.exampleEn: A doe and her fawn crossed the meadow.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir dişi geyik ve yavrusu çayırı geçti.

meanings.en: in a determined way, without giving up
meanings.exampleEn: She doggedly pursued the truth despite the obstacles.
meanings.exampleTr: Engellere rağmen gerçeğin peşinden yılmadan gitti.

meanings.en: the state of having power, control, or influence over others
meanings.exampleEn: The company established dominance in the smartphone market.
meanings.exampleTr: Şirket akıllı telefon pazarında hâkimiyet kurdu.

meanings.en: a person who gives money, organs, or blood to help others
meanings.exampleEn: The hospital is looking for a suitable organ donor.
meanings.exampleTr: Hastane uygun bir organ bağışçısı arıyor.

meanings.en: temporarily inactive but able to become active again
meanings.exampleEn: The volcano has been dormant for centuries.
meanings.exampleTr: Yanardağ yüzyıllardır uykuda.

meanings.en: sad and without hope
meanings.exampleEn: He looked downcast after hearing the results.
meanings.exampleTr: Sonuçları duyunca üzgün göründü.

meanings.en: (of eyes) looking downwards
meanings.exampleEn: She stood with downcast eyes, saying nothing.
meanings.exampleTr: Yere bakan gözlerle, hiçbir şey söylemeden durdu.

meanings.tr: düşük kaliteli, ucuz kesime hitap eden, alt segment
meanings.en: cheap and of low quality, aimed at less wealthy buyers
meanings.exampleEn: The brand moved downmarket to attract budget customers.
meanings.exampleTr: Marka, bütçe müşterilerini çekmek için alt segmente yöneldi.

meanings.en: the negative or less favourable aspect of something
meanings.exampleEn: The main downside of the job is the long hours.
meanings.exampleTr: İşin başlıca olumsuz yönü uzun çalışma saatleri.

meanings.en: a group or set of twelve
meanings.exampleEn: She bought a dozen eggs at the market.
meanings.exampleTr: Pazardan bir düzine yumurta aldı.

meanings.en: lacking brightness or interest; dull
meanings.exampleEn: The office walls were painted a drab grey.
meanings.exampleTr: Ofis duvarları donuk bir griye boyanmıştı.

meanings.tr: askere çağrılan kişi, celp edilen er
meanings.en: a person who is required by law to join the armed forces
meanings.exampleEn: The draftee reported to the base for basic training.
meanings.exampleTr: Askere çağrılan kişi temel eğitim için üsse başvurdu.
